Clean ingredients, on purpose

Coffee you can feel good about drinking.

Cloud Nine started with a simple rule: if it goes in the cup, it has to be clean. That rule built the menu — and it hasn't changed since the garage days.

01

Organic, mold-tested beans

Every shot starts with organic coffee beans that are tested for mold — the foundation of every drink on the board.

02

House-made syrups & cold foams

The syrups and signature cold foams are made in-house — including the brown sugar cinnamon cold foam on the Apple Pie Latte.

03

Seed oil-free pastries

Pastries from Two Trees Bakery, made with local California flour and no seed oils — by the register, while they last.

Our story

Started in a garage. Built at the markets. Home in Beaumont.

Kiersten started Cloud Nine at 18 years old, in her garage — one machine, a clean-ingredient rule, and a belief that a small town deserved better coffee.

For three and a half years, the trailer was the whole business: early mornings and market days across San Bernardino and Riverside counties, one cup at a time, until the lines made the next step obvious.

On November 14, 2026, Cloud Nine opened its first storefront on Beaumont Ave — with the same menu, the same rule, and the same trailer still rolling on market days.
